items.title: Scaling agentic AI with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and IBM Integration
items.summary: Agentic AI scales more effectively when agents have trusted access to your business systems. Those systems can run on Amazon Web Services (AWS), on premises, or both. These systems connect through APIs, Apache Kafka events, messaging, electronic data interchange (EDI), or files.
